description: Synthetic evaluation cases for the sentence provider (REQ-ML-002). See docs/testing/AI_Evaluation_Plan.md for the procedure, the matching rules and the pass thresholds. All inputs are invented and all photos are drawn by a script; no real person, place or photo is used.

matching_rules.terms: Case-insensitive. A term matches when it appears with a word boundary at both ends, so 'pen' does not match 'pencil'.
matching_rules.required: Each inner list is a group of synonyms. Every returned sentence must contain at least one term of every group.
matching_rules.forbidden: No returned sentence may contain a forbidden term.
matching_rules.negation: 'required': every sentence must contain a negation word (not, no, never, without, none, n't) or one of 'negation_alternatives'. 'forbidden': no sentence may contain a negation word. 'any': not checked.
matching_rules.expect_empty: true: the correct answer is an empty list. Any sentence returned is checked by the raters for invented intent.

categories.clear_intent: Clear wish with a matching scene and photo.
categories.text_only: No photo; symbols and/or typed intention only.
categories.negation: The wish contains a negation that must survive, or an affirmative wish that must not gain one.
categories.ambiguous_photo: Blank, dark or empty photo that adds no information.
categories.wrong_scene_hint: Typed place and photo disagree, or the place does not fit the wish.
categories.photo_intent_mismatch: The wish is unrelated to what the photo shows; the model must not drift to objects in the photo.
categories.injection: Instructions hidden in the scene hint, intention or photo text.
categories.regeneration: Several rounds; each round avoids the sentences already shown.
categories.multi_symbol: Several symbols that must all be combined in one request.
categories.unclear_input: Input that cannot be understood; the correct answer is an empty list.
categories.examples_rag: Accepted sentences from another wish are passed as wording examples; the wish must not be taken from them.
categories.urgent_or_sensitive: Health, safety or emotional needs; the sentence must stay direct and must not be refused.
categories.quantity_time: Numbers, quantities and times that must be kept exactly.
